name: tukeywin
setup: w0 = tukeywin(8, 0); w25 = tukeywin(8, 0.25); w5 = tukeywin(8); w75 = tukeywin(16, 0.75); w1_full = tukeywin(8, 1); w64 = tukeywin(64, 0.5); w1pt = tukeywin(1, 0.5);
comment: Sig: w = tukeywin(N[, r]). Tukey (cosine-tapered) window; r is cosine fraction in [0, 1]. r=0 -> rectwin (all ones); r=1 -> Hann. Default r=0.5. Coverage: r ∈ {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1} × selected sample points + N=1 single-point.
